user.title: Import cards from CSV
user.description:
Upload a .csv file, or paste rows from a spreadsheet, header line included. Columns: `owner`, `product` (name or catalog id), and optionally `issuer`, `role` (primary or au), `parent_owner` or `parent_last4` for authorized users, `open_date`, `fee_month`, `last4`, `nickname`, `annual_fee`, `notes`. Primary cards need an open date or fee month. Existing cards are skipped, never duplicated.

Example:
```
owner,issuer,product,role,parent_owner,fee_month,last4,annual_fee
Brian,Chase,Sapphire Reserve,primary,,February,1234,795
Nick,Chase,United Club,au,Brian,,,
```

error.nothing_to_import: Upload a file or paste some rows.

initiate_flow.user: Import statement (Chase / Amex / Capital One CSV)

user.title: Import a statement export
user.description: Upload the raw CSV or Excel file exactly as downloaded from Chase (Activity export), American Express (Download CSV), or Capital One (Download Transactions). Nothing is sent anywhere; the file is read locally, its annual fee line sets the fee month and actual fee, and labelled credit lines (for example `TRAVEL CREDIT $300/YEAR` or `Platinum Resy Credit`) are recorded as benefit usage in the matching period. Re-importing the same file is safe.

user.title: Add elite status
user.description: Status you earned outright (flights, nights, a match). Status a card gives you, such as Hilton Gold from the Amex Platinum, shows up by itself while you hold the card.

mark_used.name: Mark benefit used
mark_used.description: Record a use of a benefit for the current period. Without an amount, marks the whole benefit used.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was used. Defaults to today.

reset_benefit.name: Reset benefit
reset_benefit.description: Clear usage for the current period and set the benefit back to unused.

add_sub_spend.name: Add sign-up bonus spend
add_sub_spend.description: Add spend toward a card's sign-up bonus requirement.

set_perk_value.name: Set perk value
set_perk_value.description: Assign the annual dollar value you place on a perk (lounge access, status, insurance).

import_cards.name: Import cards
import_cards.description: Create owners and cards in bulk from CSV text. Header row required with at least owner and product; optional columns: issuer, role (primary/au), parent_last4 or parent_owner, open_date, fee_month, last4, previous_last4, nickname, color, annual_fee, notes. Rows that already exist are skipped.

csv.name: CSV
csv.description: Paste rows from a spreadsheet, including the header line.

activate_rotating_category.name: Activate rotating category
activate_rotating_category.description: Record which rotating bonus category was activated for a quarter.

quarter.name: Quarter
quarter.description: YYYY-Qn. Defaults to the current quarter.

import_statement.name: Import statement from file
import_statement.description: Read an issuer CSV export already on this Home Assistant box (for example one dropped into config/cardperks/statements/) and apply it to every card it covers. Same result as uploading it in the CardPerks settings. Safe to repeat.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path to the CSV. Relative paths are under the config folder; other folders must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

device_id.name: Card
device_id.description: Apply to this card only. Otherwise the cards are picked from the numbers in the file, or the file's issuer if it has exactly one card.

apply_fee.name: Set fee from statement
apply_fee.description: Set the fee month and actual annual fee from the statement's fee line.

add_statement_match.name: Add statement match pattern
add_statement_match.description: Teach the catalog that a credit line on a statement belongs to a benefit, so the next import records it. Writes the product to config/cardperks/catalog/ with the pattern added and reloads.

device_id.name: Card
device_id.description: A card of the product to change.

benefit_id.name: Benefit
benefit_id.description: The benefit id the credit line belongs to, as shown in the benefit entities.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression matched against the statement description, case-insensitive. Plain text works; a distinctive part of the line is enough.

stale_catalog.title: Catalog entry for {product} may be out of date
stale_catalog.description: The benefits for {product} were last verified on {last_verified}. Check the issuer page ({source_url}) and update the catalog or add an override file in `config/cardperks/catalog/`.

catalog_needs_verification.title: Catalog entries need verification
catalog_needs_verification.description: These products were drafted from general knowledge and have not been verified against the issuer: {products}. Check each against its issuer page and edit the catalog, or drop a corrected copy in `config/cardperks/catalog/`.

invalid_override.title: Catalog override file could not be loaded

statement_due.title: No recent statement for {card}
statement_due.description: The newest statement imported for {card} covers {last_month}, {months} months behind what could be covered by now. Months without a statement count as unknown rather than captured or forfeited, so this card's totals are drifting. Download the latest export from the issuer and import it (Settings, Integrations, CardPerks, Add statement).

fee_differs.title: Annual fee on {card} differs from the catalog
fee_differs.description: {card} is set to a ${card_fee} annual fee (from the statement fee line dated {seen}), but the catalog lists {product} at ${catalog_fee}. If the issuer raised the fee, update the catalog entry (or add an override file in config/cardperks/catalog/) so every holder sees the new price. If you are on an older price, leave the card as it is.
